mainObjective: Investigate the escalating bandit attacks on the Rangers' Outpost and stop the sorcerer who is corrupting the northern wilderness.

plotPoints.title: Desperate Defense
plotPoints.description: The party arrives at Rangers' Outpost to find it in crisis. Three caravans have been massacred in five days with unnatural precision. Ranger Elen, the outpost's commander, recruits the party. Her prime lead is the captured Bandit Leader, Rusk, a man now terrified of his new master. The party must interrogate Rusk to learn the location of the main bandit camp and the identity of the sorcerer, Malarok, who now commands them. IMPORTANT: This plot point should be marked COMPLETED immediately after Rusk reveals the bandit camp location (the Bandit Stronghold in the Thornwood Wilds) and Malarok's identity - do not wait for expedition planning or other preparations.

completion.impact: The party left the outpost and reached the Thornwood.

sideQuests.title: Restore the Silver Bell Network
sideQuests.description: The outpost's three silver bell towers, a magical long-range communication system, have been sabotaged by Malarok's agents. The North Tower's bell clapper was stolen. The East Tower is overgrown with magically enhanced, thorny vines. The West Tower's harmonic crystal has been shattered.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Restored bells warn the party of the ambush on the Bandit Trail (TW02).

sideQuests.title: Merchant's Dilemma
sideQuests.description: Trader Sila, the outpost's primary goods supplier, is packing to leave. Her cart of rare alchemical supplies was stolen in a raid. She asks the party to retrieve a specific iron-banded chest from a small bandit cache a few miles away. If they succeed, she'll stay.

plotPoints.title: Into the Thornwood
plotPoints.description: Following leads from Rusk, the party ventures into the Thornwood Wilds to find the main bandit camp, the Bandit Stronghold, a fortified camp deep in the wilds. They must overcome unnaturally aggressive wildlife and bandit patrols to reach the camp. Along the way they can find Gareth and Kael, two captives who escaped and are holed up in the Wolf's Den, and they learn that the other captives were already sent north. At the camp they find clues about Malarok's ultimate goal.

completion.impact: The party made it through the bandit lands to the stronghold.

sideQuests.title: The Hermit's Warning
sideQuests.description: Maelo's scrying spring is tainted, and its corrupted guardian, a Tainted Naiad, rises when anyone tries to cleanse it. Free her (Remove Curse, Lesser Restoration, or Persuasion DC 15 with an offering of clean water) or defeat her, and the spring runs clean. Maelo then scries the threat (the Voidstone at the hilltop ruins) and gives the party his Iron Charm and a flask of the purified water.

completion.impact: The spring runs clean and Maelo has scried the threat.

sideQuests.title: Rescue the Lost
sideQuests.description: The party follows tracks from the Ambush Site north to the Wolf's Den Cave where Ranger Gareth and Merchant Kael are making a desperate stand against corrupted wolves. Gareth has a partially completed map of the bandit camp's patrols. Kael overheard the bandits talking about 'gathering tributes for the master's ritual' at some 'forgotten altar'. Both survivors reveal they were being held as captives for a terrible sacrifice.

completion.impact: The corrupted wolves are dealt with.

plotPoints.title: The Corrupted Grove
plotPoints.description: The trail leads north to a blighted part of the forest where the trees are twisted and the air hums with dark energy. The party must navigate this dangerous grove to find the source of the sorcerer's power, following the increasing cold of the iron charm from Maelo.

completion.impact: The party crossed the corrupted grove and reached the source of the sorcerer's power.

sideQuests.title: Aid the Withered Hart
sideQuests.description: The forest's last guardian holds the hollow against the corruption and a maddened owlbear. Heal or steady it (the Iron Charm, Medicine DC 14, or Animal Handling DC 15) and it guides the party to the Nexus by a hidden way.

completion.impact: The Withered Hart's fate is settled.

sideQuests.title: The Ranger's Oath
sideQuests.description: Ranger Thane, sent from a distant outpost, is being consumed by the corruption at his camp. Reach him by talk (his oath, his daughter's locket) and perform the cleansing rite, and he is freed and may join the party; or grant the end he asks for.

plotPoints.title: Confronting the Corruptor
plotPoints.description: Deep within the ruins, the party finds Malarok the Corruptor. He is performing a dark ritual to absorb the power of a large, pulsating Voidstone Shard set upon an altar. He is a formidable spellcaster, protected by elite bodyguards and the stone's foul energy. The party must defeat Malarok and destroy the Voidstone to end his threat. Purified water from Maelo's spring may be crucial for cleansing the Voidstone's corruption.

completion.impact: Malarok the Corruptor is beaten and his ritual broken.

plotPoints.title: Report to Commander Elen (but she's gone!)
plotPoints.description: When the party reports their success to Ranger Marcus at the Rangers' Command Post, they discover Ranger Elen has vanished! Ranger Marcus explains that Elen received an urgent message: people are vanishing in Harrow's Hollow with the same signs of corruption seen here. She rode out at once, leaving a note: 'Disappearances in Harrow's Hollow - same signs as here. I am going. Tell our allies to follow if they can. -E' DM NOTE: In the response that narrates the report, record Ranger Elen's departure with resolveOccupant, outcome departed, reason "rode to Harrow's Hollow"; she does not join the party and does not stay. As the outpost's reward, Ranger Marcus pays each party member, companions included, fifty gold pieces from the outpost's coffers: Marcus is not a party character, so record it as an updateCharacterInfo change adding 50 gold on each party member, never transferCurrency or splitCurrency. Then wrap up this module's storylines and tell the players they can travel to Harrow's Hollow to find Elen and investigate the disappearances.

completion.impact: Commander Elen has ridden to Harrow's Hollow; the outpost's debt is paid.
